elements.name: Master traffic room
elements.about: The deck's master traffic room: tiers of controller desks facing a two-storey wall of screens. Every craft on Deck 5 is followed here from launch to landing.

elements.name: Main screen wall
elements.about: A curved wall of screens showing every craft in the sector, its height, speed and track.

elements.name: Duty director's gallery
elements.about: A glass gallery where the duty director oversees the whole room.

elements.name: Training mirror room
elements.about: A full copy of the master room, used for training and as a spare if the main room must be cleared.

elements.name: Light court
elements.about: An open court in the middle of the building that brings light and air to the inner rooms.
